sources.entry: Nextcloud Memories - Fast, modern and advanced photo management suite. Runs as a Nextcloud app. (Demo, Source Code) AGPL-3.0 PHP

summary.one_liner: Memories is a photo management suite that runs as a Nextcloud app, providing a date-based timeline, albums, map view, and AI tagging for photos and videos.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes a timeline that sorts photos and videos by date taken, parsed from Exif data, and a "Rewind" view for jumping to past dates. It supports albums that can be shared with others and external sharing links for people outside the Nextcloud instance. Photos can be placed on a map with reverse geocoding, and metadata such as dates can be edited in bulk. Other listed features include an Archive folder for hidden photos, video transcoding with HLS via a Go-based transcoder (go-vod), AI tagging by people and objects through recognize and facerecognition, and migration from Nextcloud Photos and Google Takeout. An Android client and the official Nextcloud mobile apps for automatic uploads are also mentioned.
use_cases: migrate from Google Takeout or Nextcloud Photos
how_to_run: Install the app from the Nextcloud app store.
Run `php occ memories:index` to generate metadata indices for existing photos.
Open the Memories app in Nextcloud and set the directory containing your photos.
notable: Timeline and Rewind views built from Exif capture dates
Video transcoding with HLS through the go-vod on-demand transcoder
AI tagging via recognize and facerecognition integration
Monorepo with separate lib, src, go-vod, and android packages
Claims tested on instances with over a million photos
caveats: Requires an existing Nextcloud instance; it is not standalone
Android client is described as early access
Subpackages such as go-vod carry their own licenses
